data.credibility: Management guides ambitious long-term goals like $2 billion by FY27 and $5 billion by FY31, but intermittently drops or stops mentioning them. However, specific short-term financial guidance such as tax rates is successfully met.

lines.line: $2 billion aspiration by FY27 dropped after being unmentioned for multiple quarters.
$5 billion aspiration by FY31 marked as on track despite irregular mentions.
Delivered FY26 effective tax rate of 22.6%, well within the 20% to 24% guided range.

bull: Revenue compounded at 28.6% and net profit at 32.8% annually over five years, showing strong historical growth.
Operating cash flow reached 101% of reported profit over five years, confirming profits turn cleanly into cash.
The company maintains a very low debt-to-equity ratio of 0.07 with strong ROE at 27.2% and ROCE at 34.4%.
bear: Growth is slowing, with three-year revenue growth dropping to 20.9% annually compared to 28.6% over five years.
Working-capital days have stretched significantly from 25 to 50 days over the last five years.
Borrowings have risen from ₹98 crore in FY21 to ₹575 crore in the TTM snapshot.
